interpretations.question: How should the global OperationalLimits.RequestTimeoutSeconds be classified when it has no runtime consumer at all?
interpretations.chosen: Per-operation, with an explicit audited note recording that the field is inert and that the effective timeout is the per-connection ArrConnectionConfiguration.RequestTimeoutSeconds.
interpretations.basis: ADR-028 clause 2 defines the binary classification in terms of consumers; with zero consumers no construction capture exists, and classifying it restart-required would be a false page claim. The reviewer confirmed this reading is defensible (finding 16.2-F2, noted) and disclosed.
interpretations.impact: Task 16.3 renders no restart note for this inert field. Unchanged by this correction attempt.

interpretations.question: What is the classification domain?
interpretations.chosen: Every writable property of the five configuration model types the settings page round-trips (43 settings).
interpretations.basis: ADR-028 clause 2 says 'settings', G8 requires page note-text completeness, and DashboardSettingsPageTests uses the same five types as the user-adjustable domain. Unchanged by this correction attempt.
interpretations.impact: The 19 non-limit settings are recorded per-operation with evidence; no restart-required setting can hide outside the operational limits.

interpretations.question: How does task 16.3 get the classification from the static page?
interpretations.chosen: The data-only restartRequiredFields mirror in config.html, pinned by an exact structural test (the 16.1 byteLimitFields precedent).
interpretations.basis: The page cannot read C# at runtime; the task allows a page-side mirror. Unchanged by this correction attempt.
interpretations.impact: 16.3 renders note text from it; no note text or modal is implemented here.

interpretations.question: Should BadgeSelectorConfiguration.Selector be classified?
interpretations.chosen: No; it is the fixed code-owned selector identity, not a user-adjustable field.
interpretations.basis: The page never writes it from user input. Unchanged by this correction attempt.
interpretations.impact: The reflection coverage test skips exactly that property with the documented reason.

Recorded in the classification note and the 16.2 evidence; not changed by this task; an open follow-up not assigned to any PLANS.md task (reviewer finding 16.2-F2 noted the optional limitations-register follow-up).

Sensitivity for StateRepositoryLimitsDoNotTrackAReplacementSnapshot was not shown by a runtime probe (its failure mode requires a constructor-contract change, a compile-level failure); RenderCacheQuotaBytes has code evidence, the exact-set/capture-site tests, and that value-lock, while the other six restart-required settings also have behavioral capture probes.

The per-operation classification of settings other than LibraryWorkQueue.Capacity and LogVerbosityGate is evidenced by cited consumer sites and existing suite coverage, not by a dedicated mutation probe per setting; a future singleton that begins capturing a currently per-operation setting would not be detected automatically.
